G3350.root: from a derivative of a compound of [[w:G3326]] and [[w:G3624]]
G3350.strongs: a change of abode, i.e. (specially), expatriation
senses: (= cl. μετολκία, -κησις; μετοικέω, to change one's abode), change of abode, migration: of the Babylonian exile, μ. Βαβυλῶνος, [[r:MAT.1.11|Mat 1:11-12, 17]].† (AS)

G3326.forms: μετά (before vowel μετ᾽; on the neglect of elision in certain cases, V. WH, App., 146 b)
G3326.strongs: properly, denoting accompaniment; "amid" (local or causal); modified variously according to the case (genitive association, or accusative succession) with which it is joined; occupying an intermediate position between or and or; less intimate than and less close than)
G3326.kjv: after(-ward), X that he again, against, among, X and, + follow, hence, hereafter, in, of, (up-)on, + our, X and setting, since, (un-)to, + together, when, with (+ -out)
senses: prep. with genitive, accusative (in poet, also with dative),.

Of association and companionship, with (in which sense it gradually superseded σύν, than which it is much more frequently in NT; cf. Bl., §42, 3): with genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.8.11|Mat 8:11 20:20]] [[r:MRK.1.29|Mrk 1:29 3:7]] [[r:LUK.5.30|Luk 5:30]], [[r:JHN.3.22|Jhn 3:22]], [[r:GAL.2.1|Gal 2:1]], al. mult.; εἶναι μετά, [[r:MAT.5.25|Mat 5:25]], [[r:MRK.3.14|Mrk 3:14]], al.; metaphorically, of divine help and guidance, [[r:JHN.3.2|Jhn 3:2]], [[r:ACT.7.9|Act 7:9]], [[r:PHP.4.9|Php 4:9]], al.; opposite to εἶναι κατά, [[r:MAT.12.30|Mat 12:30]], [[r:LUK.11.23|Luk 11:23]]; in Hellenistic usage (but see M, Pr., 106, 246f.), πολεμεῖν μετά = cl. π., with dative, to wage war against (so LXX for נִלְחַם עִם, [[r:1KI.17.33|1Ki 17:33]]), [[r:REV.2.16|Rev 2:16]], al.; with genitive of thing(s), χαρᾶς, [[r:MAT.13.20|Mat 13:20]], [[r:MRK.4.16|Mrk 4:16]], al.; ὀργῆς, [[r:MRK.3.5|Mrk 3:5]], al.
of association or community: μεταδίδωμι, μετέχω, etc.

G3384.strongs: a "mother" (literally or figuratively, immediate or remote)
senses: μήτηρ genitive, μητρός, ἡ, mother: [[r:MAT.1.18|Mat 1:18 2:11]], al.; figuratively, of one who takes the place of a mother, ἰδοὺ, ἡ μ. μου, [[r:MAT.12.49|Mat 12:49]] (cf. [[r:MAT.12.50|Mat 12:50]], [[r:MRK.3.35|Mrk 3:35]], [[r:JHN.19.27|Jhn 19:27]], [[r:ROM.16.13|Rom 16:13]], [[r:1TI.5.2|1Ti 5:2]]); of a city, ἥτις ἐσὶν μ. ἡμῶν, [[r:GAL.4.26|Gal 4:26]]; symbolically of Babylon, ἡ μ. τ. πορνῶν, [[r:REV.17.5|Rev 17:5]] (AS)

G3361.root: a primary particle of qualified negation (whereas [[w:G3756]] expresses an absolute denial)
G3361.strongs: (adverb) not, (conjunction) lest; also (as an interrogative implying a negative answer (whereas expects an affirmative one)) whether
G3361.kjv: any but (that), X forbear, + God forbid, + lack, lest, neither, never, no (X wise in), none, nor, (can-)not, nothing, that not, un(-taken), without
senses: subjective negative particle, used where the negation depends on a condition or hypothesis, expressed or understood, as distinct from οὐ, which denies absolutely. μή is used where one thinks a thing is not, as distinct from an absolute negation. As a general rule, οὐ negatives the indic, μή the other moods, incl, ptcp.
with ref. to thought or opinion: [[r:JHN.3.18|Jhn 3:18]], [[r:TIT.1.11|Tit 1:11]], [[r:2PE.1.9|2Pe 1:9]].

In conditional and final sentences, after εἰ, ἐάν, ἄν, ἵνα, ὅπως: [[r:MAT.10.14|Mat 10:14]], [[r:MRK.6.11|Mrk 6:11 12:19]], [[r:LUK.9.5|Luk 9:5]], [[r:JHN.6.50|Jhn 6:50]], [[r:ROM.11.25|Rom 11:25]], al.

with artic. inf.: after a prep., [[r:MAT.13.5|Mat 13:5]], [[r:MRK.4.5|Mrk 4:5]], [[r:ACT.7.19|Act 7:19]], [[r:1CO.10.6|1Co 10:6]], al.; without a prep., [[r:ROM.14.13|Rom 14:13]], [[r:2CO.2.1|2Co 2:1, 13]] [[r:1TH.4.6|1Th 4:6]]; (with) in sentences expressing consequence, after ὥστε: [[r:MAT.8.28|Mat 8:28]], [[r:MRK.3.20|Mrk 3:20]], [[r:1CO.1.7|1Co 1:7]], [[r:2CO.3.7|2Co 3:7]], al.

C. ptcp. (see M, Pr., 231f., 239), in hypothetical references to persons of a certain character or description: [[r:MAT.10.28|Mat 10:28 12:30]], [[r:LUK.6.49|Luk 6:49]], [[r:JHN.3.18|Jhn 3:18]], [[r:ROM.4.5|Rom 4:5]], [[r:1CO.7.38|1Co 7:38]], [[r:1JN.3.10|1Jn 3:10]], al.; where the person or thing being definite, the denial is a matter of opinion: [[r:JHN.6.64|Jhn 6:64]], [[r:1CO.1.28|1Co 1:28 4:7, 18]], [[r:2CO.5.21|2Co 5:21]], al.; where the ptcp. has a concessive, causal or conditional force, if, though, because not: [[r:MAT.18.25|Mat 18:25]], [[r:LUK.2.45|Luk 2:45]], [[r:JHN.7.49|Jhn 7:49]], [[r:ACT.9.26|Act 9:26]], [[r:ROM.2.14|Rom 2:14 5:13]], [[r:2CO.3.14|2Co 3:14]], [[r:GAL.6.9|Gal 6:9]], Ju 5; where the ptcp. has a descriptive force (being such as), not: [[r:ACT.9.9|Act 9:9]], [[r:ROM.1.28|Rom 1:28]], [[r:1CO.10.33|1Co 10:33]], [[r:GAL.4.8|Gal 4:8]], [[r:HEB.12.27|Heb 12:27]], al.
with subjc. praes., 1 of person(s) pl.: [[r:GAL.5.26|Gal 5:26 6:9]], [[r:1TH.5.6|1Th 5:6]], [[r:1JN.3.18|1Jn 3:18]];

with imperat. praes., usually where one is bidden to desist from what has already begun (cf. M, Pr., 122ff.): [[r:MAT.7.1|Mat 7:1]], [[r:MRK.5.36|Mrk 5:36]], [[r:LUK.6.30|Luk 6:30]], [[r:JHN.2.16|Jhn 2:16 5:45]], [[r:ACT.10.15|Act 10:15]], [[r:ROM.11.18|Rom 11:18]], [[r:JAS.2.1|Jas 2:1]], [[r:REV.5.5|Rev 5:5]], al.; (with) forbidding that which is still future: with imperat. aor., 3 of person(s), [[r:MAT.24.18|Mat 24:18]], [[r:MRK.13.15|Mrk 13:15]], [[r:LUK.17.31|Luk 17:31]], al.; with subjc. aor., 2 of person(s), [[r:MAT.3.9|Mat 3:9 10:26]], [[r:MRK.5.7|Mrk 5:7]], [[r:LUK.6.29|Luk 6:29]], [[r:JHN.3.7|Jhn 3:7]], [[r:ROM.10.6|Rom 10:6]], al.;
with optative, in wishes: [[r:2TI.4.16|2Ti 4:16]] (LXX); μὴ γένοιτο (see M, Pr., 194; Bl., §66, 1), [[r:LUK.20.16|Luk 20:16]], [[r:ROM.3.3|Rom 3:3]], al.; μή τις, [[r:MRK.13.5|Mrk 13:5]], al.

after verbs of fearing, caution, etc., that, lest, perhaps (M, Pr., 192f.): with subjc. praes., [[r:HEB.12.15|Heb 12:15]]; with subjc. aor., [[r:MAT.24.4|Mat 24:4]], [[r:MRK.13.5|Mrk 13:5]], [[r:LUK.21.8|Luk 21:8]], [[r:ACT.13.40|Act 13:40]], [[r:GAL.5.15|Gal 5:15]], al.; ὅρα μή (see M, Pr., 124, 178), elliptically, [[r:REV.19.10|Rev 19:10 22:9]]; with indic, fut. (M, Pr., l.with), [[r:COL.2.8|Col 2:8.]]
in order that not: with subjc. aor., [[r:MRK.13.36|Mrk 13:36]], [[r:2CO.8.20|2Co 8:20 12:6]].

Interrogative, in hesitant questions (M, Pr., 170), or where a negative answer is expected: [[r:MAT.7.9|Mat 7:9, 10]], [[r:MRK.2.19|Mrk 2:19]], [[r:JHN.3.4|Jhn 3:4]], [[r:ROM.3.3|Rom 3:3 10:18, 19]], [[r:1CO.1.13|1Co 1:13]], al.; μή τις, [[r:LUK.22.35|Luk 22:35]], al.; before οὐ ([[r:ROM.10.17|Rom 10:17]], al. in Pl.), expecting an affirm, ans.; οὐ μή, [[r:LUK.18.7|Luk 18:7]], [[r:JHN.18.11|Jhn 18:11]].

οὐ μή as emphatic negation (cf. M, Pr., 188, 190ff.; Bl. §64, 5), not at all, by no means: with indic, fut., [[r:MAT.16.22|Mat 16:22]], [[r:JHN.6.35|Jhn 6:35]], [[r:HEB.10.17|Heb 10:17]], al.; with subjc. aor., [[r:MAT.24.2|Mat 24:2]], [[r:MRK.13.2|Mrk 13:2]], [[r:LUK.6.37|Luk 6:37]], [[r:JHN.13.8|Jhn 13:8]], [[r:1CO.8.13|1Co 8:13]], al. (AS)

G3313.root: from an obsolete but more primary form of μείρομαι (to get as a section or allotment)
G3313.strongs: a division or share (literally or figuratively, in a wide application)
G3313.kjv: behalf, course, coast, craft, particular (+ -ly), part (+ -ly), piece, portion, respect, side, some sort(-what)
senses: a part, share, portion: [[r:JHN.13.8|Jhn 13:8]], [[r:ACT.19.27|Act 19:27]] (Page, in l), [[r:REV.20.6|Rev 20:6 22:19]]; hence (cl.), lot, destiny, [[r:MAT.24.51|Mat 24:51]], [[r:LUK.12.46|Luk 12:46]], [[r:REV.21.8|Rev 21:8]].

a part as opposite to the whole: [[r:LUK.11.36|Luk 11:36]], [[r:JHN.19.23|Jhn 19:23]], [[r:ACT.5.2|Act 5:2 23:6]], [[r:EPH.4.16|Eph 4:16]], [[r:REV.16.19|Rev 16:19]]; with genitive (of the whole), [[r:LUK.15.12|Luk 15:12 24:42]]; τ. Φαρισαίων, [[r:ACT.23.9|Act 23:9]]; pl., [[r:JHN.21.6|Jhn 21:6]]; of the divisions of a province, [[r:MAT.2.22|Mat 2:22]], [[r:ACT.2.10|Act 2:10 19:1 20:2]]; of the regions belonging to a city, [[r:MAT.15.21|Mat 15:21 16:13]], [[r:MRK.8.10|Mrk 8:10]]; with genitive appos., [[r:EPH.4.9|Eph 4:9]]; in adverbial phrases, ἀνὰ (κατὰ) μέρος, [[r:1CO.14.27|1Co 14:27]], [[r:HEB.9.5|Heb 9:5]]; μέρος τι, ἀπὸ μ., in part, [[r:ROM.11.25|Rom 11:25 15:15, 24]], [[r:1CO.11.18|1Co 11:18]], [[r:2CO.1.14|2Co 1:14 2:5]]; ἐκ μ., [[r:1CO.12.27|1Co 12:27 13:9 13:12]]; τὸ ἐκ μ., [[r:1CO.13.10|1Co 13:10]]
A class or category (in cl. usually ἐν μ. τιθέναι, λαβεῖν, etc.):ἐν μ., in respect of, [[r:COL.2.16|Col 2:16]]; ἐν τ. μ, τούτῳ, in this respect, [[r:2CO.3.10|2Co 3:10 9:3]].† (AS)

G3340.strongs: to think differently or afterwards, i.e. reconsider (morally, feel compunction)
senses: μετα-νοέω, -ῶ to change one's mind or purpose, hence, to repent; in NT (exc. [[r:LUK.17.3|Luk 17:3-4]]), of repentance from sin, involving amendment: before ἀπό, [[r:ACT.8.22|Act 8:22]]; ἔκ, [[r:REV.2.21|Rev 2:21-22 9:20-21 16:11]] (מִן שׁוּב); ἐπί, [[r:2CO.12.21|2Co 12:21]]; absol., [[r:MAT.3.2|Mat 3:2 4:17 11:20 12:41]], [[r:MRK.1.15|Mrk 1:15 6:12]], [[r:LUK.11.32|Luk 11:32 13:3, 5 15:7, 10 16:30 17:3-4]], [[r:ACT.2.38|Act 2:38 3:19 17:30 26:20 2:5, 16 2:21 3:3, 19]]; with inf., [[r:REV.16.9|Rev 16:9]]; ἐν σάκκῳ κ. σποδῷ, [[r:MAT.11.21|Mat 11:21]], [[r:LUK.10.13|Luk 10:13]].† SYN.: μεταμέλομαι, q.v (AS)

G3341.strongs: (subjectively) compunction (for guilt, including reformation); by implication, reversal (of (another's) decision)
senses: (μετανοέω), after-thought, change of mind, repentance: [[r:HEB.12.17|Heb 12:17]]; of repentance from sin, [[r:MAT.3.8|Mat 3:8, 11]] [[r:LUK.3.8|Luk 3:8 15:7 24:47]], [[r:ACT.26.20|Act 26:20]], [[r:2CO.7.9|2Co 7:9-10]]; βάπτισμα (which see) μετανοίας, [[r:MRK.1.4|Mrk 1:4]], [[r:LUK.3.3|Luk 3:3]], [[r:ACT.13.24|Act 13:24 19:4]]; ἡ εἰς θεὸν [[r:ACT.20.21|Act 20:21]]; μ. ἀπὸ νεκρῶν ἔργων, [[r:HEB.6.1|Heb 6:1]]; εἰς μ. καλεῖν, [[r:LUK.5.32|Luk 5:32]]; id. ἄγειν, [[r:ROM.2.4|Rom 2:4]]; ἀνακαινίζειν, [[r:HEB.6.6|Heb 6:6]]; εἰς μ. χωρῆσαι, [[r:2PE.3.9|2Pe 3:9]]; μ. δοῦναι, [[r:ACT.5.31|Act 5:31 11:18]], [[r:2TI.2.25|2Ti 2:25]].† (AS)

G3303.strongs: properly, indicative of affirmation or concession (in fact); usually followed by a contrasted clause with (this one, the former, etc.)
G3303.kjv: even, indeed, so, some, truly, verily
senses: conjunctive particle (originally a form of μήν), usually related to a following δέ or other adversative conjunction, and distinguishing the word or clause with which it stands from that which follows. It is generally untranslatable and is not nearly so frequent in NT as in cl. Like δέ, it never stands first in a clause.

Answered by δέ or some other particle: μὲν... δέ, indeed... but, [[r:MAT.3.11|Mat 3:11]], [[r:LUK.3.16|Luk 3:16]], al.; with pronouns, ὃς μὲν... ὃς δέ, one... another, [[r:MAT.21.35|Mat 21:35]], al.; pl., [[r:PHP.1.16|Php 1:16, 17]]; ὃ μὲν... ὃ δὲ... ὃ δέ, some... some... some, [[r:MAT.13.8|Mat 13:8]]; τοῦτο μὲν... τοῦτο δέ, partly... partly, [[r:HEB.10.33|Heb 10:33]]; μὲν... ἔπειτα, [[r:JHN.11.6|Jhn 11:6]]; μὲν... καί, [[r:LUK.8.5|Luk 8:5.]]

μέν solitarium, answered by no other particle: πρῶτον μέν (Bl., l.with), [[r:ROM.1.8|Rom 1:8 3:2]], [[r:1CO.11.18|1Co 11:18]]; μὲν οὖν in narrative, summing up what precedes or introducing something further (Bl., §78, 5), so then, rather, nay rather: [[r:LUK.11.28|Luk 11:28]] (WH, μενοῦν), [[r:ACT.1.6|Act 1:6 9:31]], al.; μὲν οὖν γε ([[r:PHP.3.8|Php 3:8]], WH): see: μενοῦνγε. (AS)

G3383.strongs: not too, i.e. (in continued negation) neither or nor; also, not even
senses: μή-τε negative particle, differing from οὔτε as μή from οὐ, neither, nor: μήτε... μήτε, neither... nor, [[r:MAT.11.18|Mat 11:18]], [[r:LUK.7.33|Luk 7:33 9:3]], [[r:ACT.23.12|Act 23:12, 21 27:20]], [[r:HEB.7.3|Heb 7:3]]; μὴ (μηδὲ)... μήτε... μήτε, [[r:MAT.5.34|Mat 5:34, 36]], [[r:MRK.3.20|Mrk 3:20]] T, [[r:ACT.23.8|Act 23:8]], [[r:2TH.2.2|2Th 2:2]], [[r:1TI.1.7|1Ti 1:7]], [[r:JAS.5.12|Jas 5:12]], [[r:REV.7.1|Rev 7:1]], 3.† (AS)

to be anxious: absol., [[r:MAT.6.27|Mat 6:27, 31]], [[r:LUK.12.25|Luk 12:25]]; μηδὲν μ., [[r:PHP.4.6|Php 4:6]]; with dative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.6.25|Mat 6:25]], [[r:LUK.12.22|Luk 12:22]]; before περί, [[r:MAT.6.28|Mat 6:28]], [[r:LUK.10.41|Luk 10:41 12:26]]; πῶς, [[r:MAT.10.19|Mat 10:19]], [[r:LUK.12.11|Luk 12:11]]; εἰς τὴν αὔριον, [[r:MAT.6.34|Mat 6:34.]]

to care for: with accusative, τὰ τ. κυριου, [[r:1CO.7.32|1Co 7:32-34]]; τὰ τ. κόσμου, [[r:1CO.7.34|1Co 7:34]]; τὰ περί ὑμῶν, [[r:PHP.2.20|Php 2:20]]; before ὑπέρ, [[r:1CO.12.25|1Co 12:25]]; with genitive (a construction otherwise unknown), ἑαυτῆς (WH; τὰ ἑ. Rec.; see Bl., § 35, 7), [[r:MAT.6.34|Mat 6:34]] (cf. προ-μεριμνάω).† (AS)

G3366.strongs: but not, not even; in a continued negation, nor
G3366.kjv: neither, nor (yet), (no) not (once, so much as)
senses: μηδέ negative particle, related to οὐδέ as μή to οὐ,

as conic., continuing a negation or prohibition, but not, and not, nor: preceded by μή, [[r:MAT.6.25|Mat 6:25 22:29]], [[r:MRK.12.24|Mrk 12:24]], [[r:LUK.14.12|Luk 14:12]], al.; ἵνα μή, [[r:JHN.4.15|Jhn 4:15]]; ὅπως μή, [[r:LUK.16.26|Luk 16:26]]; μηδέ... μηδέ, neither... nor, [[r:MAT.10.10|Mat 10:10]], [[r:1CO.10.8|1Co 10:8-9]].
As adv., strengthening a negation, not even: [[r:MRK.2.2|Mrk 2:2]], [[r:1CO.5.11|1Co 5:11]], al (AS)

G3358.strongs: a measure ("metre"), literally or figuratively; by implication, a limited portion (degree)
senses: that which is used for measuring, a measure;
a vessel: fig., [[r:MAT.23.32|Mat 23:32]], [[r:LUK.6.38|Luk 6:38]]; ἐκ μ., by measure, [[r:JHN.3.34|Jhn 3:34]];
That which is measured, measure: with genitive of thing(s), [[r:ROM.12.3|Rom 12:3]], [[r:2CO.10.13|2Co 10:13]], [[r:EPH.4.7|Eph 4:7, 13 4:16]].† (AS)

G3354.strongs: to measure (i.e. ascertain in size by a fixed standard); by implication, to admeasure (i.e. allot by rule)
senses: to measure, of space, number, value, etc.: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:REV.11.2|Rev 11:2 21:15, 17]]; with dative instr., [[r:REV.11.1|Rev 11:1 21:16]]. Metaphorical, ἑαυτὸν ἐν ἑαυτῷ, [[r:2CO.10.12|2Co 10:12.]]
to measure out, give by measure: prov., ἐν ὧ μέτρῳ κ.τ.λ., [[r:MAT.7.2|Mat 7:2]], [[r:MRK.4.24|Mrk 4:24]], [[r:LUK.6.38|Luk 6:38]] (WH, mg., cf. ἀντι-μετρέω).† (AS)

G3385.kjv: not (the particle usually not expressed, except by the form of the question)
senses: μή-τι interrog. particle, expecting a negative answer: [[r:MAT.7.16|Mat 7:16 26:22, 25]], [[r:MRK.4.21|Mrk 4:21 14:19]], [[r:LUK.6.39|Luk 6:39]], [[r:JHN.8.22|Jhn 8:22 18:35]], [[r:ACT.10.47|Act 10:47]], [[r:2CO.12.18|2Co 12:18]], [[r:JAS.3.11|Jas 3:11]]; in hesitant questions (see M, Pr., 170.), μ οὗτός ἐστιν, can this be, [[r:MAT.12.23|Mat 12:23]], [[r:JHN.4.29|Jhn 4:29]]; μ. ἄρα, [[r:2CO.1.17|2Co 1:17]]; On εἰ μήτι ([[r:LUK.9.13|Luk 9:13]], cf. Bl., § 65, 6), see: εἰ.† εἰ, conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions.
with indic, expressing a general assumption;

pres.: before indic, pres., [[r:MAT.11.14|Mat 11:14]], [[r:ROM.8.25|Rom 8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[r:MRK.4.23|Mrk 4:23 9:22]], [[r:JHN.15.18|Jhn 15:18]], [[r:1CO.7.9|1Co 7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[r:LUK.16.31|Luk 16:31]], [[r:ROM.8.11|Rom 8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[r:MAT.12.26|Mat 12:26]], [[r:ROM.4.14|Rom 4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[r:LUK.17.6|Luk 17:6]], [[r:JHN.8.39|Jhn 8:39]]; before quæst., [[r:MAT.6.23|Mat 6:23]], [[r:JHN.5.47|Jhn 5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[r:1PE.2.20|1Pe 2:20]];
Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: [[r:MAT.12.28|Mat 12:28]], [[r:JHN.7.4|Jhn 7:4]], [[r:ROM.5.17|Rom 5:17]], al.
Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).
C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: [[r:MRK.15.44|Mrk 15:44]], [[r:1JN.3.13|1Jn 3:13]], al.

C. indic., as in LXX ([[r:NUM.14.3|Num 14:3]]o, [[r:1SA.14.45|1Ki 14:45]], al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): [[r:MRK.8.12|Mrk 8:12]], [[r:HEB.3.11|Heb 3:11]]" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX).
Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: [[r:ACT.24.19|Act 24:19 27:39]], [[r:1CO.14.10|1Co 14:10 15:37]], I Pe3:14, 17.

As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[r:MAT.26.63|Mat 26:63]], [[r:MRK.15.36|Mrk 15:36]], [[r:ACT.19.2|Act 19:2]], [[r:2CO.13.5|2Co 13:5]], al.; fut., [[r:MRK.3.2|Mrk 3:2]], [[r:ACT.8.22|Act 8:22]], al.; aor., [[r:MRK.15.44|Mrk 15:44]], [[r:1CO.1.16|1Co 1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), [[r:PHP.3.12|Php 3:12.]]

As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, [[r:GEN.17.17|Gen 17:17]], al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: [[r:MRK.8.23|Mrk 8:23]] (Tr., WH, txt.), [[r:LUK.13.23|Luk 13:23, 22:49]], [[r:ACT.19.2|Act 19:2]], al.
εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε.
εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: [[r:LUK.11.18|Luk 11:18]]; but even if, [[r:1CO.4.7|1Co 4:7]], [[r:2CO.4.3|2Co 4:3 11:16]].
εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: [[r:MRK.2.21|Mrk 2:21, 22]] [[r:JHN.14.2|Jhn 14:2]], [[r:REV.2.5|Rev 2:5]], al.

εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: [[r:MAT.24.22|Mat 24:22]], [[r:MRK.2.26|Mrk 2:26 6:5]], [[r:JHN.9.33|Jhn 9:33]], [[r:1CO.7.17|1Co 7:17]] (only), [[r:GAL.1.19|Gal 1:19]] (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), [[r:1CO.14.5|1Co 14:5 15:2]], [[r:1TI.5.19|1Ti 5:19]].
εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely ([[r:EZK.33.27|Eze 33:27]], al.): [[r:HEB.6.14|Heb 6:14]].

G3367.kjv: any (man, thing), no (man), none, not (at all, any man, a whit), nothing, + without delay
senses: (and -θέν, [[r:ACT.27.33|Act 27:33]], a Hellenistic form; see Bl., 6, 7; Thackeray, Gr., 58) related to οὐδείς as μή to οὐ, no, none, no one; neut., nothing: [[r:MAT.16.20|Mat 16:20]], [[r:MRK.5.43|Mrk 5:43 6:8]], [[r:LUK.3.14|Luk 3:14]], [[r:ACT.8.24|Act 8:24]], [[r:ROM.13.8|Rom 13:8]], al.; with genitive, [[r:ACT.4.17|Act 4:17 24:23]]; neut. accusative, μηδέν, adverbially, in no respect, [[r:ACT.10.20|Act 10:20 11:12]]; as accusative obj. after verb, βλάπτειν, [[r:LUK.4.35|Luk 4:35]]; ὠφελεῖσθαι, [[r:MRK.5.26|Mrk 5:26]]; ὑστερεῖν, [[r:2CO.11.5|2Co 11:5]]; μεριμνᾶν, [[r:PHP.4.6|Php 4:6]]; in double negation, strengthening the denial, μηκέτι μ., [[r:MRK.11.14|Mrk 11:14]], [[r:ACT.4.17|Act 4:17]]; μὴ... μηδέν (μηδένα, μηδεμίαν), [[r:2CO.13.7|2Co 13:7]], [[r:2TH.2.3|2Th 2:3]], [[r:1PE.3.6|1Pe 3:6]] μηθείς, see. μηδείς (AS)

μετα-βαίνω to pass over from one place to another : [[r:MAT.17.20|Mat 17:20]], [[r:LUK.10.7|Luk 10:7]]; with reference to the point of departure only, to withdraw, depart: [[r:MAT.8.34|Mat 8:34 11:1 12:9 15:29]], [[r:JHN.7.3|Jhn 7:3]], [[r:ACT.18.7|Act 18:7]]; of removal from this life, ἐκ τ. κότμου πρὸς τ. Πατέρα, [[r:JHN.13.1|Jhn 13:1]]; metaphorically, ἐκ τ. θανάτου εἰς τ. ζωήν, [[r:JHN.5.24|Jhn 5:24]], [[r:1JN.3.14|1Jn 3:14]].† (AS)

G3306.strongs: to stay (in a given place, state, relation or expectancy)
G3306.kjv: abide, continue, dwell, endure, be present, remain, stand, tarry (for), X thine own
senses: of place: before ἐν, [[r:LUK.8.27|Luk 8:27]], al.; παρά, with dative of person(s), [[r:JHN.1.40|Jhn 1:40]], al; σύν, [[r:LUK.1.56|Luk 1:56]]; καθ᾽ ἑαυτόν, [[r:ACT.28.16|Act 28:16]]; with adv., ἐκεῖ, [[r:MAT.10.11|Mat 10:11]]; ὧδε, [[r:MAT.26.38|Mat 26:38]]; metaphorically, [[r:1JN.2.18|1Jn 2:18]]; of the Holy Spirit, [[r:JHN.1.32|Jhn 1:32, 33 14:17]]; of Christ, [[r:JHN.6.56|Jhn 6:56 15:4]], al.; ὁ θεός, [[r:1JN.4.15|1Jn 4:15]], conversely, of Christians, [[r:JHN.6.56|Jhn 6:56 15:4]], [[r:1JN.4.15|1Jn 4:15]], al.; ὁ λόγος τ. θεοῦ, [[r:1JN.2.14|1Jn 2:14]]; ἡ ἀλήθεια, II Jo 2, al.

of persons: [[r:PHP.1.25|Php 1:25]]; before εἰς τ. αἰῶνα, [[r:JHN.12.34|Jhn 12:34]], [[r:HEB.7.24|Heb 7:24]], [[r:1JN.2.17|1Jn 2:17]]; ὀλίγον, [[r:REV.17.10|Rev 17:10]]; ἕως ἔρχομαι, [[r:JHN.21.22|Jhn 21:22, 23]];
of things, lasting or enduring: cities, [[r:MAT.11.23|Mat 11:23]], [[r:HEB.13.14|Heb 13:14]]; λόγος θεοῦ, [[r:1PE.1.23|1Pe 1:23]]; ἁμαρτία, [[r:JHN.9.41|Jhn 9:41.]]

Of condition: with pred., μόνος, [[r:JHN.12.24|Jhn 12:24]]; ἄγαμος, [[r:1CO.7.11|1Co 7:11]]; πιστός, [[r:2TI.2.13|2Ti 2:13]]; ἱερεύς, [[r:HEB.7.3|Heb 7:3]]; with adv., οὕτως, [[r:1CO.7.40|1Co 7:40]]; ὡς κἀγώ, ib. 8; before ἐν, ib. 20, 24.
Trans. (Bl., §34, 1; Field, Notes, 132): with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.20.5|Act 20:5, 23]] (cf. ἀνα-, δια-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, κατα-, παρα-, συν-παρα-, περι-, προσ-, ὑπο-μένω). (AS)

G3319.kjv: among, X before them, between, + forth, mid(-day, -night), midst, way
senses: prop., as an adj.: [[r:LUK.23.45|Luk 23:45]], [[r:JHN.19.18|Jhn 19:18]], [[r:ACT.1.18|Act 1:18]]; with genitive pl., [[r:LUK.22.55|Luk 22:55]], [[r:JHN.1.26|Jhn 1:26]]; genitive temp. (Bl., § 36, 13), μέσης νυκτός, [[r:MAT.25.6|Mat 25:6]]; μ. ἡμέρας, [[r:ACT.26.13|Act 26:13.]]

In adverbial phrases, neut., μέσον, τὸ μ., as subst.: ἀνὰ μέσον, with genitive, between (cl.; in LXX: [[r:GEN.1.4|Gen 1:4]], al.), elliptically (but see M, Pr., 99), [[r:1CO.6.5|1Co 6:5]]; = ἐν μ., among, in the midst of (El., § 39, 2; 40, 8; cf. in LXX: [[r:JOS.19.1|Jos 19:1]], [[r:SIR.27.2|Sir 27:2]]), [[r:MAT.13.25|Mat 13:25]], [[r:MRK.7.31|Mrk 7:31]], [[r:REV.7.17|Rev 7:17]]; διὰ μέσου, with genitive, [[r:LUK.4.30|Luk 4:30]]; διὰ μέσον (Rec. -ου, see 81., § 42, 1), between, [[r:LUK.17.11|Luk 17:11]] (ICC, in l); εἰς τὸ μ. (see: εἰς), [[r:MRK.3.3|Mrk 3:3]], [[r:LUK.4.35|Luk 4:35 5:19 6:8]], [[r:JHN.20.19|Jhn 20:19, 26]]; εἰς μ., [[r:MRK.14.60|Mrk 14:60]]; ἐν τῷ μ., [[r:MAT.14.6|Mat 14:6]]; ἐν μ., [[r:JOS.8.3|Jos 8:3]], 9, [[r:ACT.4.7|Act 4:7]]; with, genitive loc., [[r:MRK.6.47|Mrk 6:47]], [[r:LUK.21.21|Luk 21:21 22:55]], [[r:ACT.17.22|Act 17:22]], [[r:HEB.2.12|Heb 2:12]]" (LXX), [[r:REV.4.6|Rev 4:6 5:6 22:2]]. with genitive pl., [[r:MAT.10.16|Mat 10:16 18:2, 20]], [[r:MRK.9.36|Mrk 9:36]], [[r:LUK.2.46|Luk 2:46 8:7 10:3 22:27 24:36]], [[r:ACT.1.15|Act 1:15 2:22 27:21]], [[r:1TH.2.7|1Th 2:7]], [[r:REV.1.13|Rev 1:13 2:1 5:6 6:6]]; κατὰ μέσον τ. νυκτός, [[r:ACT.27.27|Act 27:27]] (Bl., § 47, 6); ἐκ τοῦ μ. (Lft., in l; Deiss., BS, 252 f.), [[r:COL.2.14|Col 2:14]]; ἐκ μ.., [[r:2TH.2.7|2Th 2:7]]; ἐκ τοῦ μ., with genitive, [[r:MAT.13.49|Mat 13:49]], [[r:ACT.17.33|Act 17:33 23:10]], [[r:1CO.5.2|1Co 5:2]], [[r:2CO.6.17|2Co 6:17]].

Neut., μέσον, adverbially, with genitive, in the midst of, [[r:MAT.14.24|Mat 14:24]] (WH, txt., R, mg., aliter), [[r:PHP.2.15|Php 2:15]] (διὰ μέσου­see supr.-also [[r:JHN.8.50|Jhn 8:50]], R, mg.).† (AS)

G3398.strongs: small (in size, quantity, number or (figuratively) dignity)
senses: lit., of stature: [[r:MRK.15.40|Mrk 15:40]] (MM, iii, xvi; on the view that age is meant, see Deiss., BS, 144), [[r:LUK.19.3|Luk 19:3]]; οἱ μ., the little ones, [[r:MAT.18.6|Mat 18:6, 10 18:14]], [[r:MRK.9.42|Mrk 9:42]];

hence metaphorically, of rank or influence (cf. Dalman, Words, 113 f.): [[r:MAT.10.42|Mat 10:42]], [[r:LUK.17.2|Luk 17:2]], [[r:ACT.8.10|Act 8:10 26:22]], [[r:HEB.8.11|Heb 8:11]]" (LXX), [[r:REV.11.18|Rev 11:18 13:16 19:5, 18 20:12]]; compar., -ότερος, [[r:MAT.11.11|Mat 11:11]], [[r:LUK.7.28|Luk 7:28 9:48]].

G3360.strongs: as far as, i.e. up to a certain point (as a preposition, of extent (denoting the terminus, whereas refers especially to the space of time or place intervening) or conjunction)
senses: (bef. consonants, exc. [[r:LUK.16.16|Luk 16:16]], μέχρι Ἰωάνου) and μέχρις (bef. vowels, Mk, Ga, ll. with, [[r:HEB.12.4|Heb 12:4]]; see Bl., § 5, 4)
as prep., with genitive, as far as, even to, until;

As conjunct. (as long as), until: [[r:EPH.4.13|Eph 4:13]]; μ. οὗ (Thuc., iii, 28, but more frequently μ. ἄν see BI., § 65, 10), [[r:MRK.13.30|Mrk 13:30]], [[r:GAL.4.19|Gal 4:19]] (μ. is prop, an adv., cf. Lat. usgue, before prep. or adv.; LS, see word, and cf. ἄχρι).† (AS)

G3307.strongs: to part, i.e. (literally) to apportion, bestow, share, or (figuratively) to disunite, differ
G3307.kjv: deal, be difference between, distribute, divide, give participle
senses: to divide into parts : metaphorically, pass., [[r:1CO.7.34|1Co 7:34]] (WH, R, ing.), [[r:1CO.7.34|1Co 7:34]] (Rec., R, txt.) ( reading and punctuation, see ICC, in l); μεμέρισται ὁ Χριστός, [[r:1CO.1.13|1Co 1:13]]; as in late authors, of factional division (cf. Polyb., viii, 23, 9), καθ᾽ ἑαυτοῦ, [[r:MAT.12.25|Mat 12:25]]; ἐφ᾽ εαυτόν, [[r:MAT.12.26|Mat 12:26]], [[r:MRK.3.24|Mrk 3:24-26]];

to distribute: with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[r:MRK.6.41|Mrk 6:41]]; as in later usage (cf. Polyb., xi, 28, 9), to bestow: [[r:ROM.12.3|Rom 12:3]], [[r:1CO.7.17|1Co 7:17]], [[r:2CO.10.13|2Co 10:13]], [[r:HEB.7.2|Heb 7:2]]; mid., with accusative of thing(s) before μετά, [[r:LUK.12.13|Luk 12:13]] (cf. δια-, συμ-μερίζω).† (AS)

(in cl. chiefly poët.) care, anxiety: [[r:1PE.5.7|1Pe 5:7]]; pl., [[r:LUK.8.14|Luk 8:14 21:34]]; with genitive obj., [[r:MAT.13.22|Mat 13:22]], [[r:MRK.4.19|Mrk 4:19]], [[r:2CO.11.28|2Co 11:28]].† (AS)

μετα-μορφόω, -ῶ to transform, trans­figure: pass., of Christ's transfiguration, [[r:MAT.17.2|Mat 17:2]], [[r:MRK.9.2|Mrk 9:2]] (cf. [[r:LUK.9.29|Luk 9:29]]); of Christians, [[r:ROM.12.2|Rom 12:2]], [[r:2CO.3.18|2Co 3:18]].† SYN.: μετασχηματίζω, to change in fashion or appearance, see: μορφή, and cf. Lft., Phi., 125 ff (AS)

G3342.strongs: betwixt (of place or person); (of time) as adjective, intervening, or (by implication) adjoining
senses: adv. of place and time (in NT time only);
in late writers (FlJ, Plut., al.), like μετά (adv.), after, afterwards: τὸ μ. σάββατον, [[r:ACT.13.42|Act 13:42]] (cf. Cl., Ro., I Co., 44, 2).

Prep. with genitive, between: of place, [[r:MAT.23.35|Mat 23:35]], [[r:LUK.11.51|Luk 11:51 16:26]], [[r:ACT.12.6|Act 12:6]]; of persons, as to mutual relation, [[r:MAT.18.15|Mat 18:15]], [[r:ACT.15.9|Act 15:9]], [[r:ROM.2.1|Rom 2:1-29 15:1-33]].† (AS)

G3371.kjv: any longer, (not) henceforth, hereafter, no henceforward (longer, more, soon), not any more

G3338.root: from [[w:G3326]] and the middle voice of [[w:G3199]]
senses: μετα-μέλομαι depon., pass., to regret, repent one: [[r:MAT.21.30|Mat 21:30, 32 27:3]], [[r:2CO.7.8|2Co 7:8]], [[r:HEB.7.21|Heb 7:21]]" (LXX) † SYN.: μετανοέω, to change one's mind, repent. On the distinc­tion, difficult to maintain by usage, between these words, see Thayer, see word; Tr., Syn., § lxix (AS)

full: with genitive of thing(s), [[r:JHN.19.29|Jhn 19:29 21:11]], [[r:JAS.3.8|Jas 3:8]]; metaphorically, of thoughts and feelings, [[r:MAT.23.28|Mat 23:28]], [[r:ROM.1.29|Rom 1:29 15:14]], [[r:2PE.2.14|2Pe 2:14]], [[r:JAS.3.17|Jas 3:17]] (cf. Pr, l.with).† (AS)

G3379.strongs: not ever; also if (or lest) ever (or perhaps)
G3379.kjv: if peradventure, lest (at any time, haply), not at all, whether or not
senses: (= μή ποτε, and so written in WH, exc. [[r:MAT.25.9|Mat 25:9]]), negative particle, related to οὔποτε as μή to οὐ.
As neg. particle, never: [[r:HEB.9.17|Heb 9:17]] (R, mg., but see infr.; WH, txt., μή τότε).

As conjc., lest ever, lest haply (the idea of chance rather than of time seems to prevail in NT): [[r:MAT.4.6|Mat 4:6]] (LXX) [[r:MAT.5.25|Mat 5:25 7:6 13:15]]" (LXX), [[r:MAT.13.29|Mat 13:29 15:32 27:64]], [[r:MRK.4.12|Mrk 4:12]]" (LXX) [[r:MRK.14.2|Mrk 14:2]], [[r:LUK.4.11|Luk 4:11 12:58 14:12, 29]], [[r:ACT.28.27|Act 28:27]]; after verbs of fearing or taking heed, [[r:LUK.21.34|Luk 21:34]], [[r:HEB.2.1|Heb 2:1 3:12 4:1]]; with ellipse of the verb or ptcp., [[r:LUK.14.8|Luk 14:8]], [[r:ACT.5.39|Act 5:39]]; in later writers (see M, Pr., 192 f.), perhaps, [[r:MAT.25.9|Mat 25:9.]]
in direct questions, like μή, expecting a negative answer: [[r:JHN.7.26|Jhn 7:26]], [[r:HEB.9.17|Heb 9:17]], (R, txt., cf. Westc., in l; but see supr.);
in indirect questions, whether haply, if haply: [[r:LUK.3.15|Luk 3:15]], [[r:2TI.2.25|2Ti 2:25]].† (AS)

(on the spelling μείγ-, ν. B)., § 3, 5) to mix, mingle: with accusative and dative, [[r:REV.15.2|Rev 15:2]]; with accusative before ἐν, [[r:REV.8.7|Rev 8:7]]; before μετά, [[r:MAT.27.34|Mat 27:34]], [[r:LUK.13.1|Luk 13:1]].† SYN.: κεράννυμι, q.v (AS)

G3373.strongs: to lengthen, i.e. (middle voice) to enlarge
senses: (μῆκος), to lengthen, extend: of causing plants to grow, Isa, l.with; pass. (mid., Swete, in l), to grow: [[r:MRK.4.27|Mrk 4:27.]]† (AS)

μεσο-νύκτιος (on seel, μεσα-, see Bl., § 6, 2), -ον (μέσος, νύξ), of or at midnight; as subst., neut., τὸ μ., midnight (Arist. and late writers): genitive, [[r:LUK.11.5|Luk 11:5]]; μέχρι μ., [[r:ACT.20.7|Act 20:7]]; κατὰ τὸ μ., [[r:ACT.16.25|Act 16:25]]; accusative (Rec., genitive; see Bl., § 34, 8), [[r:MRK.13.35|Mrk 13:35.]]† μεσανύκτιον, see. μεσονύκτιος (AS)

μετα-δίδωμι to give a share of, impart: with dative of person(s) and accusative of thing(s) (in cl. more freq., with genitive part., but accusative of that which is imparted, whether part or whole, so here, see Bl., § 36, 1), [[r:ROM.1.11|Rom 1:11]], [[r:1TH.2.8|1Th 2:8]], and (with ellipse of accusative) [[r:LUK.3.11|Luk 3:11]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:EPH.4.28|Eph 4:28]]; absol., ὁ μεταδιδούς, [[r:ROM.12.8|Rom 12:8.]]† (AS)

G3353.strongs: participant, i.e. (as noun) a sharer; by implication, an associate
senses: sharing in, partaking of: with genitive of thing(s), [[r:HEB.3.1|Heb 3:1 6:4 12:8]]; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[r:HEB.3.14|Heb 3:14.]]
As subst., ὁ μ., a partner, associate: [[r:LUK.5.7|Luk 5:7]], [[r:HEB.1.9|Heb 1:9]]" (LXX) (AS)

G3310.strongs: a portion, i.e. province, share or (abstractly) participation
senses: In later Gk (see MM, xvi), as geographical term, a division, district: [[r:ACT.16.12|Act 16:12.]]† (AS)

G3349.root: from a compound of [[w:G3326]] and a collateral form of [[w:G0142]] or perhaps rather [[w:G0109]] (compare "meteor")
G3349.strongs: to raise in mid-air, i.e. (figuratively) suspend (passively, fluctuate or be anxious)
senses: μετ-εωρίζω (μετέωρος, (a) in mid air; (b) buoyed up; (with) in suspense; Thuc.; in π. opposite to ἀμέριμνος, see Zorell, see word) to raise on high (Thue., Xen., al.; Ob, Mi, Ez, ll with). Metaphorical,
to buoy up; pass., to be elated, puffed up (Polyb., al., [[r:PSA.2.1|Psa 2:1-12]], 3 Mac, ll. with)
to be anxious, in suspense (Polyb., see 70, 10; FlJ, BJ, iv, 2, 5): [[r:LUK.12.29|Luk 12:29.]]† (AS)

G3377.root: probably from the same base as [[w:G3145]] and [[w:G3415]] (i.e. μάω, to strive)
G3377.strongs: to disclose (through the idea of mental effort and thus calling to mind), i.e. report, declare, intimate
senses: μηνύω to disclose, declare, make known: [[r:LUK.20.37|Luk 20:37]], [[r:1CO.10.28|1Co 10:28]]; in forensic sense, to inform, report: [[r:JHN.11.57|Jhn 11:57]]; pass., with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.23.30|Act 23:30.]]† (AS)

G3323.forms: Μεσσίας, -ου, ὁ (Aram. מְשִׁיחָא = Heb. מָשִׁיחַ = Χριστός, which see)

G3355.strongs: a measurer, i.e. (specially), a certain standard measure of capacity for liquids
senses: = ἀμφορεύς, an Attic measure, = 11⁄2 Roman amphoræ or about 9 Eng. gallons: [[r:JHN.2.6|Jhn 2:6.]]† (AS)
μέν-τοι = μέν τοι, yet, however: [[r:JHN.4.27|Jhn 4:27]], al.; εἰ μ., [[r:JAS.2.8|Jas 2:8]] (if indeed). (AS)

G3322.strongs: to form the middle, i.e. (in point of time), to be half-way over
senses: (μέσός), to be in the middle, esp. of time: τ. ἑορτῆς μεσούσης, in the middle of the feast, [[r:JHN.7.14|Jhn 7:14.]]† (AS)

G3392.strongs: to sully or taint, i.e. contaminate (ceremonially or morally)
senses: in moral sense : [[r:TIT.1.15|Tit 1:15]], [[r:HEB.12.15|Heb 12:15]], Ju 8; (with) in ritual sense (cf. [[r:LEV.22.5|Lev 22:5]], al.): [[r:JHN.18.28|Jhn 18:28]].† SYN.: μολύνω, to besmear, which also differs from μ. in that it is never used, as μ. in its primary meaning, in an honourable sense (cf. Tr., Syn., § xxxi) (AS)

G3395.forms: μίγμα (LT, cl., μῖγμα; on the orthogr., see B1., § 3, 5), -τος, τό

G3370.strongs: a Median, or inhabitant of Media

G3318.strongs: Mesopotamia (as lying between the Euphrates and the Tigris; compare 0763), a region of Asia

G3325.strongs: to replenish, i.e. (by implication) to intoxicate
senses: (μεστός), to fill: pass., with genitive of thing(s), [[r:ACT.2.13|Act 2:13.]]† (AS)

G3344.strongs: to turn across, i.e. transmute or (figuratively) corrupt
senses: μετα στρέφω to turn about, turn, change: pass., [[r:ACT.2.20|Act 2:20]] (LXX), [[r:JAS.4.9|Jas 4:9]] (WH, txt., μετατρέπω, which see); in evil sense, to pervert, corrupt (cf. primary sense reverse): [[r:GAL.1.7|Gal 1:7.]]† μετα-τρέπω to turn about, turn (Hom., al., but not found in Att..): with accusative, [[r:JAS.4.9|Jas 4:9]] (WH, txt.; cf. μεταστρέφω).† (AS)

G3335.strongs: to participate; genitive case, to accept (and use)
G3335.kjv: eat, have, be partaker, receive, take
senses: μετα-λαμξάνω to have or get a share of, partake of: with genitive of thing(s), [[r:2TI.2.6|2Ti 2:6]], [[r:HEB.6.7|Heb 6:7 12:10]]; τροφῆς, [[r:ACT.2.46|Act 2:46 27:33-34]]; with accusative of thing(s) (of the whole), to get: καιρόν, [[r:ACT.24.25|Act 24:25]] (see Bl., § 36, 1; MM, xvi).† (AS)

G3351.strongs: to transfer as a settler or captive, i.e colonize or exile
senses: μετ-οικίζω (μέτοικος, an emigrant), to remove to a new abode, cause to migrate: [[r:ACT.7.4|Act 7:4, 43]]" (LXX).† (AS)
μετα-καλέω, -ῶ to call from one place to another. Mid., to send for: with accusative, [[r:ACT.7.14|Act 7:14 10:32 20:17 24:25]].† (AS)

G3346.strongs: to transfer, i.e. (literally) transport, (by implication) exchange, (reflexively) change sides, or (figuratively) pervert
G3346.kjv: carry over, change, remove, translate, turn
senses: to transfer to another place: with accusative, pass., [[r:HEB.11.5|Heb 11:5]] (LXX); before εἰς, [[r:ACT.7.16|Act 7:16]]

to change: with accusative, pass., [[r:HEB.7.12|Heb 7:12]]; before εἰς, figuratively, i.e. to make one thing a pretext for another, χάριν εἰς ἀσέλγειαν, Ju 4. Mid., to change oneself, pass over: before ἀπό and εἰς, [[r:GAL.1.6|Gal 1:6]] (cf. 2Mac, l.with).† (AS)

G3343.strongs: to send from elsewhere, i.e. (middle voice) to summon or invite
senses: μετα-πέμπω to send after or for: pass., [[r:ACT.10.29|Act 10:29]] a. Chiefly in mid., to send for, summon [[r:ACT.10.5|Act 10:5, 22 10:29]] b [[r:ACT.11.13|Act 11:13 20:1 24:24, 26 25:3]].† (AS)

G3365.root: adverb from a compound of [[w:G3361]] and ἀμός (somebody)
senses: (= μηδαμῆ, -δαμά, adv. fr. μηδαμός = μηδείς) by no means, not at all. μ., Κύριε (sc. τοῦτο γένοιτο), [[r:ACT.10.14|Act 10:14 11:8]].† (AS)

G3399.strongs: Miletus, a city of Asia Minor

G3328.strongs: to throw over, i.e. (middle voice figuratively) to turn about in opinion
senses: μετα-βάλλω to turn about, change. Pass. and mid., to turn oneself about; metaphorically, to change one's mind: [[r:ACT.28.6|Act 28:6.]]† (AS)
to exchange: τ. ἀλήθειαν... ἐν τ. ψεύδει, the truth for a lie (see Bl., § 36, 8), Rom_1:25.
to change: with accusative before εἰς, Rom_1:26 (ἀλλάσσω).† (AS)
(μή πω, LTr., in Ro, l.with), adv., not yet: with ptcp., [[r:ROM.9.11|Rom 9:11]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:HEB.9.8|Heb 9:8.]]† (AS)

G3345.strongs: to transfigure or disguise; figuratively, to apply (by accommodation)
senses: μετα-σχηματίζω to change in fashion or appearance: with accusative of thing(s), τ. σῶμα, [[r:PHP.3.21|Php 3:21]]; mid., before εἰς, [[r:2CO.11.13|2Co 11:13-14]]; before ὡς, [[r:2CO.11.15|2Co 11:15]]; of a rhetorical device, to transfer by a fiction (Field, Notes, in l), before εἰς, [[r:1CO.4.6|1Co 4:6.]]† SYN.: μεταμορφόω, q.v (AS)

G3386.strongs: not at all then, i.e. not to say (the rather still)
senses: μή-τι-γε (μήτι γε, Rec., L; μή τι γε, Tr.), strengthened form of μήτι, let alone: i.e. according to context;

G3348.strongs: to share or participate; by implication, belong to, eat (or drink)
G3348.kjv: be partaker, pertain, take part, use
senses: μετ-έχω to partake of, share in: ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι τοῦ μετέχειν, [[r:1CO.9.10|1Co 9:10]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:1CO.9.12|1Co 9:12 10:21 10:30]], [[r:HEB.2.14|Heb 2:14]]; in sacramental sense, ἑκ τ. ἐνὸς ἄρτου μ., [[r:1CO.10.17|1Co 10:17]] (cf. MM, xvi); metaphorically, γάλακτος, [[r:HEB.5.13|Heb 5:13]]; of belonging to a tribe, [[r:HEB.7.13|Heb 7:13.]]† (AS)

G3316.strongs: a go-between, i.e. (simply) an internunciator, or (by implication) a reconciler (intercessor)
senses: (μέσος), an arbitrator, mediator: [[r:GAL.3.19|Gal 3:19]]; with dupl. genitive of person(s), θεοῦ κ. ἀνθρώπων, [[r:1TI.2.5|1Ti 2:5]]; with genitive of thing(s), διαθήκης, [[r:HEB.8.6|Heb 8:6 9:15 12:24]]; ὁ δε μ. ἑνὸς οὐκ ἔστιν, [[r:GAL.3.20|Gal 3:20]] (see Lft., in l; and for exx. of this word in π., see MM, xvi).† (AS)
μεσότοιχον, -ου, τό (μέσος, τοῖχος) a partition wall: [[r:EPH.2.14|Eph 2:14]] (not elsewhere, but see LS, see word μεσότοιχος).† (AS)

G3334.strongs: to stir to a place elsewhere, i.e. remove (figuratively)
senses: μετα-κινέω, -ῶ trans., to move away, remove (ὅρια, Deu, l.with). Mid., to remove oneself, remove, shift: metaphorically, ἀπὸ τ. ἐλπίδος, [[r:COL.1.23|Col 1:23.]]† (AS)
μητρολῴας (Rec. -αλῴας, in cl., -αλοίας, see B1., § 3, 3; 6, 2), -ου, ὁ (μήτρρ + ἀλοιάω, to smite)
a matricide: [[r:1TI.1.9|1Ti 1:9]] (AV, R, txt., but see infr.);
a smiter of his mother: [[r:1TI.1.9|1Ti 1:9]] (R, mg., cf. [[r:EXO.21.15|Exo 21:15]], and see Ellic., CGT, in l).† (AS)
a dividing, division: ψυχῆς κ. πνεύματος (i.e. between them or of the things themselves, see Westc., in l), [[r:HEB.4.12|Heb 4:12.]]

G3356.root: from a compound of the base of [[w:G3357]] and [[w:G3806]]
G3356.strongs: to be moderate in passion, i.e. gentle (to treat indulgently)
senses: (μετριοπαθής, moderating one's passions), to hold one's passions or emotions in restraint; hence, to bear gently with, feel gently towards: [[r:HEB.5.2|Heb 5:2.]]† (AS)

G3375.strongs: a particle of affirmation (only with); assuredly
senses: μήν a particle of assurance, verily, truly; εἰ (εἶ) μ. (= cl., ἦ μ. in LXX and π.), now verily, full surely: [[r:HEB.6.14|Heb 6:14]] (LXX).† (AS)

G3315.strongs: to interpose (as arbiter), i.e (by implication) to ratify (as surety)

G3331.strongs: transposition, i.e. transferral (to heaven), disestablishment (of a law)
senses: change, as of that which has been established : [[r:HEB.7.12|Heb 7:12 12:27]].† (AS)
in Xen., Plut., and later writers, to transfer, transport (so LXX).
In sense other­wise unknown (see Hort, in l), to turn about, direct: [[r:JAS.3.3|Jas 3:3-4.]]† (AS)
(μιαίνω), chiefly in trag. and late writers; a stain, defilement: pl., [[r:2PE.2.20|2Pe 2:20.]]† (AS)

G3321.root: from a presumed compound of [[w:G3319]] and [[w:G3772]]
senses: (μεσουρανέω, to be in mid-heaven, of the sun at the meridian), the zenith, mid-heaven: [[r:REV.8.13|Rev 8:13 14:6 19:17]].† (AS)
